description: Hiring intent score (0-100) for a company domain, from its public job board: hiring status, open roles, postings in the last 30 days, functions and technologies. A heuristic signal, not confirmed purchase intent. Use when an agent ranks accounts by hiring activity. $0.01; no board or no jobs is free. Job listings: get_company_open_jobs.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domain.description: Hostname only, e.g. stripe.com; not a keyword or placeholder.

name: get_company_hiring_intent

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

confidence.description: high: the company website links to the board. unverified: only the board name matches the domain.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up calls on the same domain, with the exact body. Optional to use.

title: Hiring Intent Score
